import sys, math, json, time
from pathlib import Path
import cv2
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from rcb_brush import Session

INSTANCE='/app/instance.json'
OUT='/app/output/trajectory.npz'
SPEED=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0.020
WIDTH_SCALE=float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 1.00

s=Session(instance=INSTANCE)
s.reset(); p=s.primitives(); s.record_start()
# The centerline polylines follow the medial axes of the eight standard strokes.
# Coordinates are target pixels (u right, v down).
paths=[
 ('1-pie',[(503,257),(475,263),(447,273),(419,286),(391,298),(363,309),(335,320),(309,329),(284,335)]),
 ('2-heng',[(231,447),(249,452),(268,454),(290,451),(315,446),(343,439),(372,432),(401,426),(430,420),(459,414),(486,409),(511,404)]),
 ('3-shu',[(400,294),(405,313),(407,340),(407,370),(406,400),(405,430),(404,463),(403,500),(402,540),(401,580),(400,625),(399,670),(399,715),(399,750),(399,775)]),
 ('4-pie',[(405,435),(402,453),(395,472),(385,493),(372,515),(357,540),(340,565),(321,591),(299,617),(275,643),(247,667),(219,675)]),
 ('5-na',[(408,512),(425,516),(443,522),(461,531),(478,543),(496,556)]),
 ('6-kou-left',[(547,450),(553,469),(558,491),(563,516),(568,543),(572,571),(576,599),(579,622),(579,639)]),
 ('7-kou-fold',[(548,451),(570,446),(596,440),(624,434),(652,428),(678,423),(697,421),(710,424),(719,431),(723,440),(722,454),(719,474),(715,497),(711,522),(707,547),(703,567)]),
 ('8-kou-bottom',[(578,604),(598,600),(622,595),(649,590),(677,585),(704,581),(727,578),(742,577)]),
]
# Target mask and local width field (distance to its boundary).
gray=cv2.imread('/app/target.png',cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
target=(gray<128).astype(np.uint8)
dist=cv2.distanceTransform(target,cv2.DIST_L2,5).astype(np.float64)
geo=s.geo

def arc_resample(points, spacing_px=7.0):
    q=np.asarray(points,float)
    ds=np.hypot(np.diff(q[:,0]),np.diff(q[:,1])); ss=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(ds)]
    n=max(2,int(math.ceil(ss[-1]/spacing_px))+1)
    u=np.linspace(0,ss[-1],n)
    return np.column_stack((np.interp(u,ss,q[:,0]),np.interp(u,ss,q[:,1])))

def dip():
    # Well contact is above its rigid plate and below the ink surface.
    p['move_tip']([-0.100,0.150,0.027],speed=0.040)
    p['hold'](8)
    p['move_tip']([-0.100,0.150,0.065],speed=0.035)

# Lift initial brush and make the first dip.
p['move_tip']([0.0,0.0,0.065],speed=0.035)
dip()
log=[]
for name,control in paths:
    pix=arc_resample(control,7.0)
    # Tangent in pixels and distance transform give a pressure profile that matches the exemplar's local apparent width.
    tang=np.gradient(pix,axis=0)
    tl=np.maximum(1e-6,np.linalg.norm(tang,axis=1)); tang=tang/tl[:,None]
    # pixels -> world unit tangent: x_world follows -v, y_world follows -u
    ew=np.column_stack((-tang[:,1],-tang[:,0]))
    xx=np.clip(pix[:,0],0,1023); yy=np.clip(pix[:,1],0,1023)
    half=map_coordinates(dist,[yy,xx],order=1,mode='nearest')
    # At a junction the union silhouette is much wider than its individual branch; cap to the plausible branch envelope.
    half=np.clip(half,1.5,22.0)
    width_m=2.0*half*geo.px_m*WIDTH_SCALE
    press=np.clip((width_m+0.00030)/1.187,0.0010,0.0115)
    # Wang fitted offset, as a function of press depth (cm -> m), along local travel direction.
    zcm=press*100.0
    off_cm=np.maximum(0.0,-0.967*(zcm-1.091)**2+1.115)
    off=off_cm/100.0
    root_xy=np.asarray(geo.px_to_world(pix[:,0],pix[:,1])).T
    tip_xy=root_xy+off[:,None]*ew
    # Inked, lifted transfer to a fresh-dipped brush; every new main-sheet contact is one of the intended eight strokes.
    dip()
    # Orient the brush in the stroke direction while hovering, then descend at the first root+offset point.
    z_hover=0.052
    q0=tip_xy[0]-ew[0]*0.020
    p['move_tip']([q0[0],q0[1],z_hover],speed=0.035)
    p['move_tip']([tip_xy[0,0],tip_xy[0,1],z_hover],speed=SPEED)
    p['move_tip']([tip_xy[0,0],tip_xy[0,1],0.020-press[0]],speed=SPEED)
    maxfail=0
    for k in range(1,len(pix)):
        pos=geo.px_to_world(pix[k,0],pix[k,1])
        pos=np.asarray(pos)+off[k]*ew[k]
        rr=p['move_tip']([pos[0],pos[1],0.020-press[k]],speed=SPEED)
        maxfail=max(maxfail,rr['ik_failures'])
    # Lift vertically before moving to the well/next path.
    end=np.asarray(geo.px_to_world(pix[-1,0],pix[-1,1]))+off[-1]*ew[-1]
    p['move_tip']([end[0],end[1],0.055],speed=0.025,settle=3)
    actual=s.tip_pose()[0]
    log.append({'stroke':name,'n_waypoints':len(pix),'length_px':float(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pix,axis=0),axis=1))),
                'press_mm':[float(press.min()*1000),float(press.max()*1000)],'ik_failures':maxfail,
                'end_error_mm':float(np.linalg.norm(actual-np.array([end[0],end[1],0.055]))*1000)})
    print(log[-1],flush=True)

acts=s.record_stop()
s.save_trajectory(acts,OUT,meta={'script':'gen.py','speed':SPEED,'width_scale':WIDTH_SCALE,'routes':log})
print('saved',OUT,'actions',acts.shape,'status-local',s.status() if s.truth is not None else {'steps':s.n_steps,'strokes':len(s.strokes()),'loaded':s.brush_state()['loaded']},flush=True)
# Save local rendered ink for inspection (not part of replay deliverable).
cv2.imwrite('/app/output/ink.png',np.uint8(np.clip(s.ink()*255,0,255)))
